description: Shared per-wave configuration for Story, Arcade and PvE battles: layout, time/force-gauge rules, enemies, order/task links and battle music.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_MissionWave. Waves are resolved by ids from the enclosing mission or by PvE lottery results. Beyond being the key, the value is copied into PvESettings.PickedWaveIds on PvE result entry and passed into situation-overview parameters, so it also acts as a stable wave tag.

MissionLayoutIndex.simple: Selects which map layout to use for spawn positions.
MissionLayoutIndex.technical: int32, default 0. AGameBattleManager::GetCharacterStartTransform requires MapRow->Id_MissionLayout to be a valid index and non-None at this position; the resulting id is resolved against MissionLayoutDataTables. A value of -1 or any out-of-range index skips the mission layout override and keeps the battle area's transform. Exported rows include -1.

TimeLimit.simple: Wave-specific battle time limit in seconds.
TimeLimit.technical: float, default 0.0f. If > 0, UGamePhase_BattleMissionBase::GetBattleTimeLimit returns it instead of the battle-level request's TimeLimit or Global TimeLimit[0]. If < 0, GetBattleTimeLimitInfinite returns true regardless of the level request. A value of 0 means fall back to the level/global setting. The versus-enemy interval widget displays a special infinite label for negative values and uses Global TimeLimit[0] when the value is 0. Exported rows use -1, 0 and positive values such as 30/60.

ForceGaugeMax.simple: Maximum force gauge stock for side 1 in this wave.
ForceGaugeMax.technical: int32, default 0. UGamePhase_BattleMissionBase::GetBattleSideRule and UGamePhase_BattlePvEBase::GetBattleSideRule read it for Side==1; a value of 0 is replaced with the default 4, while other values (including exported -1) are returned as-is. Side 0 in PvE is instead derived from binding vows, and mission-base side 0 stays 4.

Id_MissionCharacter_Enemy.simple: Ordered list of enemy mission-character rows for the wave.
Id_MissionCharacter_Enemy.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. Index 0 is used by root-info, situation-overview and interval UI previews. Battle-entry builders use Index-2 for enemy slots (slots 0/1 come from the player pair), resolving each non-None id against MissionCharacterDataTables; some paths omit bounds checks. The first-wave enemy list is also used to gather unique character ids for image preloading. Exported arrays are padded with None.

bRevivalEnabled.technical: TArray<bool>, default empty. It is aligned with the enemy character array and copied by index into FStudioBattleCharacterSetup::StatusSetup.Byte4D in Story (Index) and Arcade/PvE (Index-2). Downstream code tests StatusSetup.Byte4D: value 1 allows BounceUp follow-ups and prevents immediate disappearance/deactivation on defeat; value 0 can release traps on deactivation. Entries are not uniformly true in the export.

Id_MissionOrder.technical: FName, default None. Resolved against MissionOrderDataTables (DTM+0x9D0) in SetupArcade/SetupPvE/SetupStory and in many widgets. Passing the id through Battle_FindMissionOrderRow with bCheckNone=true lets None yield a null order. The order then drives win conditions, UI text and boss behaviour; the wave id is also passed to wave-transition widgets.

Id_MissionTaskLottery.simple: Lottery row used to pick the wave's mission task.
Id_MissionTaskLottery.technical: FName, default None. Arcade setup calls BattleArcade_PickLotteryTask on it (wave +0x48); PvE settings reuse that helper; Story demo helpers resolve a MissionTaskLottery row from it and use the first candidate. A null or empty lottery yields no task rather than a crash in the observed helpers.

Id_Bgm.simple: Battle music row for this wave.
Id_Bgm.technical: FName, default None. GetBattleBgmName resolves it through BgmDataTables with bCheckNone=true; if no row is found it falls back to Game->StudioBattleLevelRequest_CA0.BgmId and finally to BGM_BATTLE_01. The returned value is the Bgm row's CueSheetName (or an empty name when empty).

notes: The exported asset has 1774 rows with FGameDataTableRow_MissionWave; the manager loads MissionWaveDataTable into MissionWaveDataTables (DTM+0x9A0). StoryMissionWaveDataTable is a separate join table and is not this table.

The active wave pointer is cached in FStudioBattleMissionTaskSystem (AGameBattleManager::GetMissionWave). Many consumers referenced as Wave are aliases of that pointer; the UI/interval paths instead resolve the row directly from an id.
Exported rows use fixed-width arrays padded with None; gameplay consumers do not consistently validate parallel array lengths before indexing.
Finders and entry builders are reconstructed (status/functions.json labels several behavioural). No claim is made about all retail or Blueprint uses because Content is partial.

usages.detail: Uses MissionLayoutIndex to select spawn locations/rotations.
Uses TimeLimit, ForceGaugeMax and Id_Bgm to set battle rules and music.
Resolves story mission waves into MissionWave rows and builds enemy entries from Id_MissionCharacter_Enemy and bRevivalEnabled.
Arcade setup resolves every wave and picks a task from Id_MissionTaskLottery.
Caches the wave, mission order and task for the active retry index.
First-wave enemy list drives root-select previews and character texture gathering.
